item.description: Doctors say pontiff is ‘fit for discharge’ after operation to remove cancerous tumour from his lung Pope Leo lung cancer surgery: what kind of operation did he have and what happens next? Leo, 71, was deemed “fit for discharge”, his doctors, Luigi Carbone and Stefano Margaritora, said in a statement published by the Vatican. Continue reading... item.title: Lone, starless cloud may be a 'dark' galaxy
item.description: Astronomers using China's FAST radio telescope have discovered a compact cloud of hydrogen with no visible stars or galaxy around it. This could be one of the strongest candidates yet for an isolated "dark galaxy," containing nearly 500,000 times the sun's mass in neutral hydrogen. The discovery paper was posted to the arXiv preprint server on Sept. 24. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Over 1,000 residents oppose A$15bn data centre planned near Wagga Wagga
item.description: A proposed A$15 billion data-centre campus near Wagga Wagga has ignited a heated community conversation. Local residents express concerns about the impact on agricultural land, increased energy requirements, and ripple effects on the environment. Conversely, advocates highlight the prospects of enhanced economic growth and job opportunities for the area. The state government will assess these implications before making a final decision, with residents urging thorough evaluations to address their worries. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Phulpati Dashain Messages: Nepal PM and President urge unity; Shah recalls Bhotekoshi floods
item.description: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah and President Ramchandra Paudel share heartfelt festive wishes for Bada Dashain, underlining family cohesion and social harmony. In light of recent floods, Shah expresses sympathy for those affected while advocating for recovery efforts. Paudel notes the festival’s significance in fostering goodwill and cultural richness across Nepal’s communities, urging citizens to cherish their traditions and unite in celebration despite struggles. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: In Tirana, a large assembly of students is rallying for Prime Minister Edi Rama's resignation, citing rampant corruption.
